breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d⁴/32 throughout all torsion calculations (shear stress and angle of twist), completely omitting the erroneous instruction to use the bending second moment I = π d⁴/64 in torsion formulas. This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
